tldr: 華許正式接掌聯準會，同日美國消費者信心創歷史新低、理事華勒轉鷹，市場對「快降息」預期瞬間被拔錨。
台灣首季 GDP 衝上 13.69% 創 39 年新高，4 月電力景氣燈號連 12 紅，AI 拉動的島內超級景氣循環獲實質驗證。

A record NT$4,815 億 of life-insurance policy surrenders in Q1 signals a structural re-allocation from in-force policies into Taiwan equities — wealth-management front lines must reset retention scripts.
壽險業首季解約金衝上 4,815 億元，反映保戶將既有保單資金轉進台股的結構性挪移，財管前線留客話術需要重寫。
AMD 蘇姿丰喊「AI 賽局才打到第三局」、晶片 ETF 由高通領軍創高，但美銀 Hartnett 警告 AI 加超大型 IPO 集中度已逼近歷史泡沫水位。
地緣風險重新定價：川普與賴清德通話已在準備、美國同時暫停 140 億美元對台軍售以挪移彈藥支援伊朗戰事。

items.title_zh: 熱錢回流台股、新台幣連 3 升收 31.568 元
items.title_en: Hot money chases Taiex; NTD strengthens to NT$31.568, third straight session of gains
items.summary_zh: 5/22 新台幣兌美元收盤升 2.7 分至 31.568 元，連 3 升，輝達財報激勵台股，外資匯入推升匯價。路透同步揭露央行私下安排大型企業集中買匯，以承接熱錢、緩和升勢，反映央行雙向調節壓力升高。
items.summary_en: The Taiwanese dollar closed up 2.7 cents at 31.568 against the greenback on May 22, the third consecutive session of appreciation, as Nvidia's results triggered inflows into Taiex names. The central bank, per Reuters, is privately arranging large corporates to buy USD to absorb the inflow and slow the appreciation pace.

items.title_zh: 國巨董事長陳泰銘躍居台灣首富、擠下郭台銘
items.title_en: Chen Tai-ming of Yageo overtakes Terry Gou as Taiwan's richest
items.summary_zh: 在 MLCC 與 LK Group 整合綜效、被動元件搭上 AI 議價力大躍升的背景下，陳泰銘身價首度超越鴻海創辦人郭台銘，象徵台灣富豪榜的世代轉移：上游關鍵元件公司的毛利擴張力，已壓過代工廠規模優勢。
items.summary_en: Riding Yageo's MLCC + LK Group rally and a surge in passive-component pricing power into the AI build-out, Chairman Chen Tai-ming's net worth has overtaken Hon Hai founder Terry Gou's, marking a generational shift in Taiwan's wealth ladder driven by component (vs. assembler) margin expansion.

items.title_zh: 中鋼董座黃建智：好業績看到 7 月、接單出貨佳
items.title_en: China Steel sees solid orders through July; chairman flags healthy momentum
items.summary_zh: 中鋼董事長黃建智表示，接單與出貨表現佳，目前能見度看到 7 月。作為台灣旗艦級下游鋼鐵廠，這份樂觀指引顯示基礎建設、AI 資料中心建廠與造船需求支撐力道仍強，傳統鋼鐵循環同步受惠 AI 投資。
items.summary_en: Chairman Huang Chien-chih said order intake and shipments remain strong, with visibility extending through July. The optimistic guidance from Taiwan's flagship downstream steel maker hints at sustained demand from infrastructure, AI data-center build-outs and shipbuilding.

items.title_zh: 台泥進擊歐洲：新能源 + 低碳水泥雙箭齊發
items.title_en: Taiwan Cement doubles down on Europe with renewables + low-carbon cement
items.summary_zh: 台泥於股東會公布歐洲雙軌布局：在南歐與瑞士建置新能源/儲能資產，同時將低碳水泥推進歐盟 CBAM 市場。這宣告台泥從本土水泥業者，加速轉型為跨歐元區的綠能 + 碳邊境機制套利營運商。
items.summary_en: At its AGM, TCC laid out a two-track European strategy: building energy-storage and renewables assets across Southern Europe and Switzerland while pushing low-carbon cement into EU CBAM markets. The shift signals TCC's transformation from a domestic cement player into a green-energy/EU compliance-arbitrage operator.

items.title_zh: AMD 蘇姿丰：AI 才打到「第三局」、資料中心商機看上兆美元
items.title_en: AMD's Lisa Su: AI is "in the third inning," data-center TAM heading to US$1 trillion
items.summary_zh: 蘇姿丰昨在台北明確駁斥 AI 泡沫論，主張九局棒球比喻下現在只是「第三局」，並預估未來 3–4 年資料中心相關商機將達 1 兆美元規模。隨推論型工作負載爆量，CPU 將扮演越來越關鍵的角色，呼應其重押台廠供應鏈的策略邏輯。
items.summary_en: At a Taipei event, AMD Chair/CEO Lisa Su dismissed AI-bubble fears, calling the build-out "third inning of a nine-inning game" and projecting data-center-related opportunities to scale to US$1 trillion over the next 3-4 years. CPUs, she emphasized, will play an increasingly central role as inference workloads explode.

items.title_zh: 三星李在鎔抵台會晤聯發科蔡力行、晶圓代工訂單揣測升溫
items.title_en: Samsung's Lee Jae-yong meets MediaTek's Rick Tsai in Taipei — foundry order speculation flares
items.summary_zh: 韓聯社報導，三星電子會長李在鎔 5/21 在台與聯發科執行長蔡力行就合作事宜會面，三星正力推晶圓代工以承接 AI 晶片需求。市場揣測聯發科有機會將部分先進製程訂單分散給三星，這對台積電在頂尖節點的議價地位構成增量壓力。
items.summary_en: Yonhap reported that Samsung Electronics chairman Lee Jae-yong met MediaTek CEO Rick Tsai in Taiwan on May 21 to discuss cooperation, as Samsung accelerates its foundry push to capture surging AI silicon demand. The meeting fuels speculation that MediaTek may diversify some leading-edge orders to Samsung — a potential incremental headwind for TSMC's pricing power at the very high end.

items.title_zh: 集邦：2026 AI 伺服器出貨估增 28%、鴻海廣達加速建廠
items.title_en: TrendForce: 2026 AI-server shipments to grow 28%, Foxconn/Quanta accelerate capex
items.summary_zh: 集邦科技上修 2026 年 AI 伺服器出貨年增至 28%，鴻海、廣達等一線 ODM 廠加速擴建廠房。此次上修反映輝達/AMD 在機架級平台（GB300、Helios）的猛攻，加上亞洲與中東主權 AI 需求成長，對台廠設備、機殼與電源管理供應鏈形成中期單。
items.summary_en: Research house TrendForce now sees AI-server shipments rising 28% in 2026, driving Foxconn, Quanta and other Tier-1 ODMs to expand factory footprints. The upgrade reflects Nvidia/AMD's intensified push into rack-scale platforms (GB300/Helios) and growing sovereign-AI demand from Asia and the Middle East.

items.title_zh: 記憶體三雄質變：華邦電搶利基、南亞科強攻伺服器 DDR5
items.title_en: DRAM trio repositions: Winbond targets niche, Nanya pushes high-spec DDR5 for servers
items.summary_zh: 台廠記憶體三雄迎來質變轉機：華邦電聚焦利基型 Flash、南亞科加速高規 DDR5 卡位伺服器、力積電同步調整路線。伺服器級記憶體與商規 DRAM 利差大幅拉開，三家有機會在 2026 年同步迎來獲利躍升。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's three memory players are entering a qualitative inflection: Winbond doubling down on niche flash markets, Nanya Tech aggressively scaling high-spec DDR5 for server platforms, and Powerchip recalibrating. With server margin spread widening sharply over commodity DRAM, the trio is positioned for a 2026 profit step-up.

items.title_zh: 大摩拆解輝達下一代「AI 怪獸」、4 種零件用量暴漲
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley dissects Nvidia's next-gen "AI monster" — 4 component categories set to surge
items.summary_zh: 摩根士丹利拆解輝達次世代 AI 平台，鎖定四類零件含量出現倍增成長：高階玻纖布、ABF 載板、先進封裝（CoWoS/CPO）、高速 CCL 銅箔基板。台廠受惠者包含台光電、欣興、景碩、南電，2026 下半年將是供需最緊俏的窗口。
items.summary_en: Morgan Stanley's teardown analysis of Nvidia's next-generation AI platform identifies four component categories with explosive content growth: high-end glass-fiber cloth, ABF substrates, advanced packaging (CoWoS/CPO) and high-speed copper-clad laminates. Taiwan beneficiaries include Taiwan Union Tech, Unimicron, Kinsus and Nan Ya PCB.

items.title_zh: 遠東商銀有意併購、董座周添財揭兩大難題
items.title_en: Far Eastern International Bank chairman: open to M&A but flags two key hurdles
items.summary_zh: 遠東商銀董事長周添財公開證實有意尋找併購標的，外傳鎖定兩家中型銀行，但坦言面臨兩大難題：價格認知差距與併購後整合風險。金管會推動金融業擴大規模政策下，中型銀行的整併話題持續升溫。
items.summary_en: Far Eastern International Bank (FEIB) Chairman Chou Tien-tsai publicly confirmed the bank is exploring acquisition targets, with two specific candidates speculated. However, he flagged two principal hurdles: valuation gap and post-merger integration risk. Active mid-tier bank consolidation talk continues as the FSC pushes financial-sector scale-up.

items.title_zh: 金管會核准林昭廷正式接任國泰人壽總經理
items.title_en: FSC approves Lin Chao-ting as new CEO of Cathay Life
items.summary_zh: 國泰金控 5/22 公告，原國泰人壽代理總經理林昭廷已獲金管會核准，正式出任總經理並即日生效。林昭廷的拍板，確立台灣最大壽險公司在面對解約壓力與高股票配置週期的管理層延續性。
items.summary_en: Cathay Financial Holdings announced on May 22 that the FSC has formally approved Lin Chao-ting (previously acting CEO) as the official President & CEO of Cathay Life, effective immediately. Lin's appointment cements management continuity at Taiwan's largest life insurer as it navigates surrender-pressure and a high-equity-allocation cycle.

items.title_zh: 金管會督導期交所推國外成分 ETF 期權三階段漲跌幅機制
items.title_en: FSC rolls out three-stage daily price-limit mechanism for foreign-component ETF futures/options
items.summary_zh: 金管會指示期交所就追蹤海外指數（如美股科技、日股）的 ETF 期貨與選擇權，導入三階段漲跌幅熔斷型機制，分階段擴大漲跌限制，吸收海外隔夜震盪、避免台北盤無秩序跌停，降低槓桿產品系統性風險。
items.summary_en: The FSC instructed TAIFEX to implement a three-stage circuit-breaker-style daily price-limit regime for futures and options on ETFs that track foreign indices (e.g., US tech, Japan equities). The phased structure is designed to absorb overnight overseas-market volatility without triggering disorderly limit-down conditions in Taipei session.

items.title_zh: 五大銀行房貸動能降溫
items.title_en: Top-5 bank mortgage origination momentum cools
items.summary_zh: 五大行庫房貸承作金額明顯降溫，反映選擇性信用管制持續發酵、全台新案待售庫存逼近 20 萬戶，加上首季 GDP 過熱削弱降息正當性。此趨勢意味銀行業房貸利息收入動能下半年將面臨壓力。
items.summary_en: Mortgage origination at Taiwan's five largest banks shows clear momentum deceleration, reflecting the lingering impact of selective credit controls, rising new-home inventory now nearing 200,000 units nationwide, and a Q1 GDP backdrop too strong to justify near-term rate cuts. The data implies bank net-interest-income growth from mortgages will face headwinds into 2H26.

items.title_zh: 首季壽險解約金衝 4,815 億創高、台股創高吸金
items.title_en: Record NT$481.5 bn of life-insurance surrenders in Q1 as Taiex highs siphon policyholder cash
items.summary_zh: 據壽險公會，3 月解約給付年增 282 億元，累計首季解約金額達 4,815 億元，反映保戶將舊保單變現追逐台股創高行情的結構挪移。台幣投資型保單與美元傳統型保單帶動雙引擎承接，但對 RM 而言，留客話術已直接和股票市值漲幅 FOMO 競爭，需要重新設計客戶資產整體配置敘事。
items.summary_en: Per the Life Insurance Association, March alone saw surrender payouts up NT$28.2 bn YoY, with full Q1 surrender payouts reaching NT$481.5 bn — a structural surge driven by policyholders cashing out in-force policies to chase the Taiex's record run. NTD investment-linked policies and USD traditional policies have so far cushioned net cash flows, but client-retention conversations now have to compete with mark-to-market equity FOMO.

items.title_zh: 壽險百億神單再添一張
items.title_en: Another NT$10 bn "single-ticket" life-insurance mega-policy lands
items.summary_zh: 月內再現一張單筆破百億元的躉繳壽險神單，反映高資產客戶在台股狂熱中對保證型/結構型保險商品的避險需求未減。壽險公司透過大額單一保單穩住 AUM、補回解約缺口，財富管理端可同步觀察結構型壽險商品的傳承功能需求回溫。
items.summary_en: A second large single-premium policy north of NT$10 bn has been written this month, underscoring HNW client appetite for guaranteed/structured insurance products as a defensive sleeve amid equity-market euphoria. Insurers are using these mega-policies to bolster AUM stability and offset surrender-driven outflows.

items.title_zh: 國壽熱銷防癌保單 5 月底停售
items.title_en: Cathay Life's best-selling cancer policy halts sales at month-end
items.summary_zh: 國泰人壽旗下熱銷防癌險將於 5 月底停售，市場掀起最後加保潮。防癌保單面臨重新定價週期（治療成本、長壽風險），對財富管理客戶而言，是審視家庭健康保障缺口、汰換舊單的時間窗，也是 RM 與客戶重啟保險規劃對話的切點。
items.summary_en: Cathay Life's flagship cancer protection policy — among the most popular health-protection products on the market — will be pulled from sales at end-May, triggering a final-window buying rush. This is an inflection point for the cancer-policy segment as carriers reset pricing for evolving treatment costs and longevity assumptions.

items.title_zh: 逾 4 成上班族 2025 靠股票獲利、380 萬資產才有「安全感」
items.title_en: Survey: 42% of salaried workers profited from stocks in 2025; NT$3.8 mn is the "safety" threshold
items.summary_zh: 1111 人力銀行調查：37.5% 偏好 ETF/基金、36.1% 以存款為主、高風險操作不到 1 成；逾 4 成受訪者去年在股市獲利，受訪者認為需擁有 380 萬元資產才有「安全感」。對大眾富裕客群（mass affluent）的 RM 開發策略而言，這是一個可校準分眾覆蓋模型的客戶心理門檻。
items.summary_en: A 1111 Job Bank poll found 37.5% of salaried workers prefer ETFs/funds, 36.1% prioritize savings, and under 10% engage in high-risk trades. Over 42% gained in equity markets in 2025, with respondents pegging NT$3.8 mn in assets as the minimum "financial safety" line — a useful psychographic benchmark for mass-affluent RM coverage models.

items.title_zh: Incrementum：金價下一站 8,900 美元、回調即買點
items.title_en: Incrementum: gold's next stop is US$8,900/oz, every pullback is a buy
items.summary_zh: 資產管理機構 Incrementum 重申金價多年期超級多頭目標 8,900 美元/盎司，主張每次回檔皆為加碼點，理由是央行去美元化、主權債貨幣化風險與地緣摩擦持續。同步呼應臺銀「黃金王子」楊天立 4,500 美元為進場點觀點，對 HNW 客戶黃金/實體貴金屬部位配置具參考性。
items.summary_en: Asset manager Incrementum reiterated an ultra-bullish multi-year gold target of US$8,900/oz, framing every correction as a buy opportunity, with structural drivers cited as central-bank de-dollarization, sovereign-debt monetization risk and persistent geopolitical friction. The view complements Bank of Taiwan's "Gold Prince" Yang Tien-li who recently called US$4,500/oz an entry point — both targeting HNW gold sleeves.

items.title_zh: 央行為企業美元配息訂原則：股利幣別不宜各季頻繁變更
items.title_en: CBC sets ground rules for USD dividend distributions: avoid frequent currency-switching
items.summary_zh: 金管會開放上市櫃公司可對外資股東發放外幣現金股利後，央行同步提出核心操作原則：股利幣別「不宜在各季頻繁變更」，避免市場對匯率形成過度預期或投機聯想。上市公司財務/稅務團隊在規劃美元配息政策時，應視為具拘束力的軟性指引。
items.summary_en: After the FSC opened the door for listed companies to pay foreign-currency cash dividends to non-resident shareholders, Taiwan's central bank (CBC) has laid down core operational principles — most importantly, "do not switch dividend currency frequently across quarters," to prevent the FX market from forming distorted expectations or speculative positioning around dividend cycles. Tax/treasury teams at listed corporates should treat this as a binding soft-law constraint when planning USD dividend policy.

items.title_zh: 赴美投資國家融資保證首案現身：台灣中油在休士頓建 TAIWAN TOWER
items.title_en: First "US Investment Sovereign Guarantee" deal lands: CPC builds Taiwan Tower in Houston
items.summary_zh: 攸關企業赴美投資的國家融資保證機制將於 6 月公布 15 家銀行出資額度，知情人士指首案為台灣中油在休士頓既有土地興建 TAIWAN TOWER 商辦。此機制是台灣將龐大經常帳順差導向美國實質資產、同時管控稅務與匯率對稱性的政策工具，對企業稅務規劃影響重大。
items.summary_en: The first case under Taiwan's national financing-guarantee mechanism for outbound US investment will be unveiled in June. Per knowing sources, CPC Corporation Taiwan will build the "TAIWAN TOWER" office complex on existing land in Houston. The mechanism — with 15 participating banks and quota allocations already finalized — is a key tool funneling Taiwan's record current-account surplus into US real-asset investments while managing tax/FX symmetry.

items.title_zh: 2026 報稅季：高雄國稅局示警執行業務者 5 大錯誤
items.title_en: 2026 tax filing: NTA Kaohsiung flags 5 common errors by self-employed professionals
items.summary_zh: 財政部高雄國稅局提醒執行業務者（醫師、律師、會計師、代書等）申報綜所稅常見 5 大錯誤：1) 漏報扣繳憑單收入；2) 漏報補助款；3) 獨資負責人列報自身薪資為費用；4) 列報與業務無關費用；5) 未區分家庭合用部分。對 RM 而言，這是針對醫師、律師等高所得執行業務客戶申報季的核心提醒清單。
items.summary_en: Kaohsiung National Taxation Bureau warns self-employed professionals (e.g., physicians, attorneys, accountants, agents) to avoid 5 frequent income-tax filing errors: (1) under-reporting withholding statement income, (2) under-reporting subsidies, (3) sole-proprietor declaring own salary as expense, (4) declaring business-unrelated expense, and (5) failing to apportion mixed-use household items. Critical checklist for wealth-management clients with executive-professional profiles.

items.title_zh: 金管會推資源與實作工作坊、協助企業接軌 IFRS 永續揭露準則
items.title_en: FSC rolls out resources + workshops to help corporates adopt IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布配套資源與實作工作坊，協助企業導入 IFRS S1/S2 永續揭露準則，包含實務範本、情境分析支援與分層培訓。上市櫃公司分階段強制適用將延續至 2027 年，對董事會評估遵循成本、與稅務協同的 ESG 揭露具關鍵意義。
items.summary_en: The FSC announced a package of resources and hands-on workshops to assist Taiwan corporates with the IFRS S1/S2 Sustainability Disclosure rollout, including practical templates, scenario analysis support and tiered training. With phased mandatory adoption running through 2027 for listed companies, the package is critical for boards weighing compliance cost and tax-aligned ESG reporting.

items.title_zh: 華許正式宣誓接任 Fed 主席，面對通膨與升息預期雙重考驗
items.title_en: Kevin Warsh sworn in as Fed Chair amid high inflation and renewed hiking expectations
items.summary_zh: 川普提名的華許 (Kevin Warsh) 5/22 正式宣誓就任 Fed 主席，接替鮑爾。他接手的局面極為棘手：油價推升通膨、消費者信心創歷史新低、市場開始押注升息（非降息）。同日 Fed 理事華勒 (Waller) 釋出鷹派訊號，支持移除聲明中「寬鬆傾向」措辭，意味下次會議升降息機率打平。川普則同步喊話「利率將很快下降」，政治與貨幣政策的拉扯重新開戰。
items.summary_en: Trump-nominated Kevin Warsh formally took the Fed Chair oath on May 22, replacing Jerome Powell. He inherits a hostile mix: oil-driven inflation, record-low consumer confidence, and a market that is now pricing in possible rate hikes (not cuts). Same-day, Fed Governor Christopher Waller flagged support for removing the policy statement's "easing bias" language, signaling the Fed could move either way at the next meeting. Trump simultaneously called for rates to "come down very soon" — the political-monetary tension is restarting.

items.title_zh: 國發會：台灣首季 GDP +13.69%，創 39 年新高
items.title_en: Taiwan Q1 GDP roars to 13.69% — 39-year high — driven by AI exports
items.summary_zh: 國發會證實 2026 年首季實質 GDP 年增 13.69%，創 39 年新高，主要由 AI 相關出口（半導體、AI 伺服器、網通設備）驅動。此數據遠超區域同業，強化央行抗拒短線寬鬆政策的論據，即便面臨房貸動能降溫壓力，央行也不易在此時降息。
items.summary_en: The National Development Council confirmed Taiwan's Q1 2026 GDP growth at 13.69% YoY, the highest in 39 years, propelled by AI-related exports of semiconductors, AI servers and networking equipment. The print far outpaces regional peers and reinforces the case for the central bank to resist near-term policy easing despite mortgage-cooling pressure.

items.title_zh: 4 月電力景氣燈號連 12 紅、AI 高效運算需求強勁
items.title_en: April power-consumption index flashes red for 12th straight month — AI overheat warning
items.summary_zh: 台綜院公布 4 月電力景氣燈號續亮紅燈，已「連 12 紅」，反映 AI 需求帶動半導體與資通訊產業產能滿載。全國高壓以上產業用電持續成長，4 月半導體用電年增率顯著，同時也再次點燃供電穩定性與電網彈性的政策辯論。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Research Institute reported April's power-consumption index remained "red-hot" — the 12th consecutive red signal — confirming high-performance computing (HPC) and cloud demand are driving full-load utilization at semiconductor and ICT manufacturers. Industrial high-voltage electricity demand continued to climb, prompting renewed grid-reliability concerns.

items.title_zh: 美國暫停 140 億美元對台軍售、挪移彈藥支援伊朗戰事
items.title_en: US pauses US$14 bn arms sale to Taiwan to redirect munitions to Iran war
items.summary_zh: 美國海軍代理部長高雄 (Hung Cao) 5/21 表示，因應美伊戰爭需求，華府正暫停一筆 140 億美元的對台軍售。此凍結是華府印太承諾與中東軍事節奏首次明確衝撞，立即推升台海嚇阻信用度的折價風險。
items.summary_en: Acting US Navy Secretary Hung Cao stated on May 21 that Washington is suspending a US$14 bn arms sale to Taiwan to ensure sufficient munitions inventory for the ongoing Iran conflict. The freeze marks the first overt collision between US Indo-Pacific commitments and Middle East operational tempo, and immediately re-prices Taiwan-Strait deterrence risk.

items.title_zh: 川普擬與賴清德通話：路透曝美台官員已接觸但未定案
items.title_en: Trump-Lai phone call in preparation — US-Taiwan officials in contact, plan not yet locked
items.summary_zh: 路透引述四名知情人士報導，美台官員已就川普與賴清德可能通話進行接觸，但目前仍停留在討論階段，尚未建立具體安排。一旦成真，將打破美國數十年涉台外交慣例，為美中關係與台海局勢注入重大新變數；北京已警告此舉將損害雙邊關係。
items.summary_en: Reuters reported (citing four sources) that US and Taiwan officials are in active discussions on a potential phone call between Donald Trump and Taiwan President William Lai Ching-te, though no concrete arrangement has been made yet. If realized, it would break decades of US precedent and inject substantial new variables into US-China and Taiwan-Strait dynamics. Beijing has warned the move would harm bilateral relations.

items.title_zh: 道瓊再創新高、標普 500 連 8 周收紅、寫 2023 年來最長紀錄
items.title_en: Dow hits new high, S&P 500 logs 8 consecutive weekly gains — longest streak since 2023
items.summary_zh: 美股 5/22 續揚，市場消化美伊和談進展與華許接任 Fed 主席利多，道瓊工業指數再創歷史新高，標普 500 指數連 8 周收紅，寫下自 2023 年來最長周線連漲紀錄，多頭廣度在總經逆風下依然強勢。
items.summary_en: US equities extended their rally on May 22 as markets digested progress in US-Iran peace talks and Warsh's confirmation. The Dow set a fresh all-time high; the S&P 500 notched its eighth consecutive weekly gain — the longest streak since 2023 — confirming bull-market breadth despite macro headwinds.

items.title_zh: 高通單日飆漲近 12%、月線 +75%：華爾街重押 AI 裝置題材
items.title_en: Qualcomm surges nearly 12% in one session, +75% in a month — Wall Street re-rates AI-device play
items.summary_zh: 高通 (QCOM-US) 5/22 大漲近 12%，月內累計漲幅達 75%，華爾街重新評價其在實體 AI / 邊緣 AI 裝置浪潮的核心地位，股價創歷史新高，並帶領 iShares 半導體 ETF (SOXX) 同步觸及盤中新高——這也是本輪反彈首次由非輝達的個股領軍。
items.summary_en: Qualcomm (QCOM-US) jumped nearly 12% on May 22, with cumulative one-month gains hitting 75%, as the Street re-rates its central role in the physical-AI / edge-AI device wave. The stock set an all-time high and led the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) to a fresh intraday peak — the first time a non-Nvidia name has driven the chip-stock rally in this cycle.

items.title_zh: 輝達財報優於預期、股價反應淡定，華爾街稱估值更具吸引力
items.title_en: Nvidia: post-earnings pullback, but Street says valuation now looks more attractive
items.summary_zh: 巴隆周刊指輝達 (NVDA-US) 財報再優於預期，但股價反應相對平淡，分析師反而認為當前估值較數月前更具吸引力。Factset 最新調查將 NVDA 目標價上修至 285 美元 (+3.64%)，長期型法人在拉回中重新介入。
items.summary_en: Per Barron's, Nvidia (NVDA-US) beat consensus on its latest report but the share-price reaction was muted. Analysts now flag the valuation as more compelling than it has been in months — Factset's latest survey lifted NVDA's target price to US$285 (+3.64%). Long-only investors are re-engaging on dip.

items.title_zh: 美銀 Hartnett 警告：AI + 超大型 IPO 集中度逼近歷史泡沫水位
items.title_en: Bank of America's Hartnett: AI + mega-IPO concentration approaching historic bubble levels
items.summary_zh: 美銀首席策略師 Hartnett 警告，隨 SpaceX 與 OpenAI 蓄勢推出超大型 IPO，科技股在美股指數的權重可能超越歷次泡沫高峰水準，市場集中度已逼近歷史狂熱期。這是 2026 年迄今主要投資銀行策略師最高分貝的泡沫警示，對配置型機構是重要 risk-on/risk-off 訊號。
items.summary_en: BofA's chief investment strategist Michael Hartnett warned that with SpaceX and OpenAI poised for record-size IPOs, tech's share of US equity indices could exceed prior bubble peaks. Market concentration is now flirting with historic-mania territory. The call is the highest-profile bubble warning of 2026 from a major-bank strategist.

items.title_zh: 美國 5 月消費者信心終值 44.8、創歷史新低
items.title_en: US May consumer-confidence final: 44.8 — all-time low; inflation expectations climb
items.summary_zh: 密西根大學 5 月消費者信心終值跌至 44.8，低於市場預期與初值 48.2，較 4 月 49.8 再下滑，創歷史新低。伊朗戰爭推升油價與生活成本，長期通膨預期同步攀升，重挫快降息敘事，並為新任 Fed 主席華許製造首道難題。
items.summary_en: University of Michigan's final May consumer-confidence index plunged to 44.8, below both consensus and the preliminary 48.2, and down from April's 49.8 — a fresh all-time low. The drop is driven by Iran-war-induced oil-price spikes and surging living costs; long-term inflation expectations climbed in tandem, undercutting the rate-cut narrative.
